French Bulldog colors, keep every one: white body; black face mask; black ears; black saddle on the back; white muzzle; white chest; brown eyes; black nose; pink inner ears. Hard constraints, do not draw any of these: base, plinth, pedestal, plate, stand, podium, ground or floor, text or letters, keyring, loop or hole.
